{{Quote|Pardon me, old gumball machine, if you can, but I'm going aft to change into my bathing togs.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="LCatSoTB">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref>}}
'''Swimsuits''',<ref name="Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref> also known as '''swimwear'''<ref name="Cartel">[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]]</ref> or '''bathing togs''',<ref name="LCatSoTB" /> were an item of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] worn by individuals while [[Bath/Legends|bathing]] or swimming.<ref name="XWRS 32" /> One brand of swimsuit was the [[Aquawear]], which was advertised by [[AthleticGal]] on the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN">[[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'' website]]</ref>
